answer: To price out identity farms, a new agent must dock a refundable bond at a public registry jetty before it can earn. Bonds thaw on a glacier timetable: principal unlocks only after many consecutive epochs of graded work with no correlated-key flags. Each epoch the agent signs a quill-hashed work log that peers compare for reused phrasing and key clustering. Spinning up hundreds of sockpuppets therefore immobilizes capital for months and risks slashing when logs correlate, making mass sybil creation unprofitable.
